title: figmaTokens
description: Design tokens aligned with Figma themeColors and the Size PDF panel grid. Declares CSS custom properties for colors, typography, spacing, and radii under @layer tokens.

--font-stack.description: Primary UI font stack (Inter + system fallbacks).

--figma-color-bg-primary.description: Primary surface background; overridden by themeColors when available.

--figma-color-bg-brand.description: Brand/accent blue used for primary actions.

--bg-main.description: Alias of primary background for Size PDF components.

--bg-field.description: Alias of secondary background for input fields.

--color-primary.description: Alias of brand color for Size PDF components.

--width-field.description: Standard field width in the 3-column panel grid (74px).

--row-gap.description: Gap between columns in the panel grid (6px).
